verdict.rationale: ANEF is the French portal for foreign nationals, so documenting a non-resident path is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains only probes. They show a ~3 KB JavaScript shell with under 200 characters of text, and a Cloudflare 403 on the parent ministry site. No page content documents eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, or extra steps for non-residents, so there is no evidence the capability is delivered.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
